# ux4g-web-components

CSS bundle, design tokens, utilities, and runtime module for the **UX4G Design System**.

This is the single package you need — it provides the complete CSS system, interactive behaviors, and all component classes. Use directly in HTML, Angular, or React via standard CSS classes.

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install ux4g-web-components
```

---

## Setup

### Option 1: CDN (No build tools needed)

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>My UX4G Page</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.ux4g.gov.in/UX4G@3.0.18/index.css" />
</head>
<body>
  <button class="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md">Get Started</button>
  <script src="https://cdn.ux4g.gov.in/UX4G@3.0.18/ux4g.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.ux4g.gov.in/UX4G@3.0.18/ux4g-custom.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

### Option 2: Plain HTML (Local)

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/ux4g-web-components/styles/ux4g.css" />
</head>
<body>
  <button class="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md">Save</button>
  <script src="node_modules/ux4g-web-components/dist/runtime/design-system.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

### Option 3: Angular

In `angular.json`:
```json
{
  "styles": ["node_modules/ux4g-web-components/styles/ux4g.css"],
  "scripts": ["node_modules/ux4g-web-components/dist/runtime/design-system.js"]
}
```

### Option 4: React

In your entry file (`src/main.tsx`):
```tsx
import 'ux4g-web-components/styles.css';
import 'ux4g-web-components/design-system';
```

---

## Available Exports

| Export Path | Description |
|---|---|
| `ux4g-web-components/styles.css` | Pre-built CSS bundle (~8 MB, fonts embedded as base64) |
| `ux4g-web-components/design-system` | Side-effect import — auto-initializes runtime (recommended) |
| `ux4g-web-components/runtime` | `initRuntime()` / `destroyRuntime()` — explicit control |

---

## CSS Bundle

Layer order (strict — do NOT reorder):

1. **Reset** — browser normalization
2. **Tokens** — CSS custom properties (primitive values)
3. **Semantic** — semantic aliases
4. **Foundations** — fonts and icons (base64-embedded)
5. **Utilities** — 27 single-purpose helper class modules
6. **Components** — all component CSS
7. **Layout** — container, flex-grid, grid utilities
8. **Cascade Fixes** — vendor specificity overrides

---

### Button

#### HTML

```html
<button class="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md">Filled</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-outline-primary ux4g-btn-md">Outline</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-tonal-primary ux4g-btn-md">Tonal</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-text-primary ux4g-btn-md">Text</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md" disabled>Disabled</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md ux4g-radius-full">Pill</button>
```

#### Angular

```html
<button class="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md">Filled</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-outline-primary ux4g-btn-md">Outline</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-tonal-primary ux4g-btn-md">Tonal</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-text-primary ux4g-btn-md">Text</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md" disabled>Disabled</button>
<button class="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md ux4g-radius-full">Pill</button>
```

#### React

```tsx
<button className="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md">Filled</button>
<button className="ux4g-btn-outline-primary ux4g-btn-md">Outline</button>
<button className="ux4g-btn-tonal-primary ux4g-btn-md">Tonal</button>
<button className="ux4g-btn-text-primary ux4g-btn-md">Text</button>
<button className="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md" disabled>Disabled</button>
<button className="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md ux4g-radius-full">Pill</button>
```

#### Available Classes

| Category | Classes |
|---|---|
| Variants | `ux4g-btn-primary`, `ux4g-btn-outline-primary`, `ux4g-btn-tonal-primary`, `ux4g-btn-text-primary`, `ux4g-btn-danger`, `ux4g-btn-outline-danger`, `ux4g-btn-text-danger`, `ux4g-btn-outline-neutral`, `ux4g-btn-text-neutral` |
| Sizes | `ux4g-btn-xl`, `ux4g-btn-lg`, `ux4g-btn-md` (default), `ux4g-btn-sm`, `ux4g-btn-xs` |
| Shape | `ux4g-radius-full` (pill) |

## Runtime Module

The runtime provides interactive behaviors via event delegation. No per-element binding needed.

### Auto-Bootstrap (Recommended)

```ts
import 'ux4g-web-components/design-system';
```

### Explicit Control

```ts
import { initRuntime, destroyRuntime } from 'ux4g-web-components/runtime';
initRuntime();
destroyRuntime(); // cleanup
```

### Behaviors Provided

| Behavior | Trigger |
|---|---|
| Dropdown | `.ux4g-dropdown-control` |
| Modal | `data-modal-target`, `data-close-modal` |
| Tooltip | `.ux4g-tooltip-wrapper` hover |
| Popover | `data-ux-toggle="popover"` |
| Accordion | `data-ux4g-accordion-toggle` |
| Tab | `.ux4g-tab-item` click |
| Carousel | `data-ux4g-carousel-prev`, `data-ux4g-carousel-next` |
| Drawer | `data-drawer`, `data-drawer-close` |
| Mega Menu | `.ux4g-mega-menu-category-item` click |
| Alert | `.ux4g-alert-close`, `data-auto-dismiss` |

---

## Utility Classes

27 modules of single-purpose helper classes:

```html
<div class="ux4g-d-flex ux4g-gap-m ux4g-p-l ux4g-bg-primary-soft ux4g-radius-md">
  <span class="ux4g-body-m-default ux4g-text-neutral-primary">Content</span>
</div>
```

| Category | Modules |
|---|---|
| Typography & Text | `typography`, `typescale`, `colors`, `text-transform`, `vertical-align` |
| Layout & Spacing | `spacing`, `sizing`, `gap`, `object-fit`, `overflow`, `position`, `z-index`, `visibility`, `display`, `display-responsive` |
| Flexbox & Grid | `flex`, `flex-responsive`, `align`, `justify`, `order` |
| Visual Effects | `background`, `border`, `radius`, `shadow`, `opacity`, `blur` |
| Interaction | `interaction` |

---

## Dark Theme

```html
<html data-theme="dark">
  <!-- All components automatically use dark tokens -->
</html>

<!-- Or scope to a section -->
<div data-theme="dark">
  <button class="ux4g-btn-primary ux4g-btn-md">Dark button</button>
</div>
```
